children: RailTel Corporation of India has secured an order worth approximately ₹27.03 crore from Andhra Pradesh Technology Services for the design, development, implementation, hosting and managed services of a Statewide Legal AI Assistant Platform for the Andhra Pradesh government.
In a regulatory filing dated November 22, 2026, the state-owned telecommunications and IT services company said it had received the Letter of Acceptance (LoA) for the domestic contract.
The estimated order value is ₹27,02,56,350, including taxes. The project is scheduled to be executed by May 9, 2029.
The order involves the design, development, implementation, hosting and managed services of a Statewide Legal AI Assistant Platform for the Government of Andhra Pradesh on Google Cloud Platform.
The contract has been awarded by Andhra Pradesh Technology Services, and RailTel will undertake the project as a domestic order.
According to the company's disclosure, the estimated order size is ₹27.02 crore, including taxes.
RailTel is required to execute the order by May 9, 2029.
The company received the Letter of Acceptance on November 21, 2026, at 5:29 pm, according to the regulatory filing.
The disclosure also stated that the order does not involve any interest from the promoter or promoter group in the awarding entity and does not fall under related-party transactions.
RailTel Corporation of India shares closed at ₹249.15, declining ₹2.50 or 0.99% in the previous trading session. The stock opened at ₹250.70. It has a 52-week high of ₹391 and a 52-week low of ₹220.

title: RailTel wins ₹27 crore order to develop Legal AI platform for Andhra Pradesh government
